at-0001.title: Round money only with round_money
at-0001.content: Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

at-0003.content: Reject invalid input by raising `BillingError` from `ledgerly.errors` with a stable snake_case code such as `invalid_state`, `invalid_quantity` or `negative_amount`, and pass the offending value as the message.

at-0006.title: Money-moving ops need idempotency_key checked first
at-0006.content: Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance (e.g. `refund` in `ledgerly/adjustments.py`) must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it before any state validation: scan `ledgerly.audit.events()` for an entry with the same key and return the original record without reapplying. Include `idempotency_key` in the `audit.record` entry.
